limits: Observer pixels/poses are pre-action, not the final post-action observation; last recorded frame is not proof of the exact terminating criterion.
Recorded body bearing is not camera visibility or human_following; pixel thresholds cannot be substituted with heading.
Pixel counts are observer-only diagnostics and must not be fed to policy RPC or used as future target/GT inputs.
No unseen geometry is inferred; constrained translation does not identify which obstacle was contacted.
WA RGB+simulated polar UWB and released LightNav inputs differ; paired environment comparison is not a same-modality architecture ablation.
HumanCollision in evt_bench/additional_metric.py is distance_to_leader<0.5m or historical occurrence. It is target-proximity collision, not a general static/dynamic obstacle contact metric.
Shared SSD semantic warnings and occasional full-frame target-pixel values limit visual causality claims; completed matched runs alone do not prove semantic rendering error absent.
Independent confirmation must not become recovery training data. Any next intervention requires training-only examples and a separately held-out future validation.

The existing971 teacher windows contain useful near-target recovery but no AT windows at absolute bearing>=0.78rad; naive repetition cannot add absent coverage. Continuous target-pixel labels are not present in that cache.
